title: 88-byte record copy construction
summary: Recovered VA 0x542120 as a thiscall member operation: 22 ascending 32-bit load/store pairs followed by returning this; caller at 0x5420e0 confirms 88-byte range stride. No helper calls or external side effects.
test_description: Compare accepted original at 0x542120 with recovered member for 69 inputs: uniform zero/all-one/sign-bit/NaN-like/arbitrary bits and distinct per-word patterns. Check all 22 words, return pointer, source preservation, surrounding canaries, self-copy, and initialized FS head restoration after every original call.
known_limits: Original field names and semantic types remain unknown; uint32_t words preserve their representations without inventing ownership.
Null or inaccessible pointers fault in the original and are outside valid C++ object preconditions; fault behavior is not tested.
Original ascending accesses imply forward propagation on partial overlap; partial overlap is not tested because overlapping Record88 object lifetimes are not a portable C++ object model.
No byte-matching claim or broader caller recovery.
